entities.summary: Mike Krack is a Luxembourgish motorsports engineer. Since 2025, he has been serving as the Chief Trackside Officer at Aston Martin; he previously served as the team’s Team Principal. Krack had also previously worked at BMW Sauber, Porsche and BMW.
